items.q: Why does he say interruption feels easy?
items.a: Low **vocal presence** and low **visual presence** make you look finished. He still assumes they are trying to **add a thought they might forget**.

items.q: What do you do in the moment?
items.a: Hold **3–4 seconds**, and stay paused after they finish. Then thank them with **less melody**, ask to finish your thought, and hand the turn back.

items.q: How do you make the next interruption harder?
items.a: **Stand**, and use more voice and body. If they still cut in, say it **one-on-one**: it hurt, and it undermined you with the team. Do not take it to the rest of the room.
